body: claimed: UMA · 2026-11-12T04:43Z · branch issue/1066-ladder-entry-height (mkinney fork, synced at v0.18.0) · plan: reproduce first (2D op on a feature whose mouth sits below a taller stock top, nothing machined ahead); if a rapid/plunge into stock passes the laws, raise to P0 and fix the ladder top from the prior stock (or refuse by name); else pin the catching law and close

Reproduced on upstream/main a6bd69d8 (v0.18.0 + #1032). **Raised to P0**: one of the three 2D kinds posts a rapid into uncut stock silently.

Fixture: a 40 x 40 x 20 part with a 20 x 20 blind hole (mouth Z 20, floor Z 10) in a 60 x 60 box standing 5 mm over the mouth (top Z 25), nothing faced ahead, EM-0800-4FL, default plunge height 2 mm. The ladder's entry rapid goes from clearance Z 40 to Z 22, 3 mm inside the block.

| op (source) | entry rapid | verdict on main |
|---|---|---|
| 2D Pocket (floor face picked), top 20 | 40 -> 22 | `RapidInStock { at: 0 }`, post blocked |
| Contour (whole part), top 20 | 40 -> 22 | `RapidInStock`, post blocked (already pinned by `vertical_rapid_stock.rs`) |
| Bore (source = stock, hole entry_z 20) | 40 -> 22 | **no warning, posts** |
| Bore (source = part) | 40 -> 22 | `RapidInStock { at: 0 }`, post blocked |
| Drill, R plane 22 (stock or part source) | - | refused by the R-plane law at generate |

Cause: the rapid law (#96, `sim::verify::rapids_in_stock`) asks `rest.in_stock(q)`, which reads `VerifyContext::stock` and falls back to the op's region when that is `None`. For a source that IS the stock, `job.rs` leaves the stock facets `None`. For Bore and Thread, the region is the stock's footprint with the holes' rim loops punched out (`material_source::source_region`). So every column inside the hole read as "not stock", and the dive into the uncut column above the mouth was never judged.

Fix on the way: when the source is the stock and the kind is Bore or Thread, verify reads the unpunched stock (`material_source::judged_stock`). The ladder itself is unchanged, so the rapid law convicts the dive and the post gate blocks it, the same as Pocket and Contour. A face ahead to the mouth still clears it (`acquit_by_prior`).
